title: T115 Task Map: port Archify routing, overlap detection and zoom readability
head: t115-taskmap-port
body:
Task Map now uses the Archify layout engine for routes, overlap checks and readable zoom.

## What
- Step 1: Port edge routing and route-quality score (grid, routing, routeQuality, geometry/textFit/utils subsets in src/components/taskmap/archify/), layout.ts and React TaskMap.tsx in place of the placeholder; enable with TASK_MAP_ENABLED=true. The 10-task fake fixture scores 96.
- Step 2: Add overlap checks with spatialGrid.ts and layout.overlaps. The 10- and 60-task fixtures have 0 overlaps, including focus; forced overlap is found, and grid results match brute force.
- Step 3: Add readability.ts from desktop-readability.mjs. The map floor is TASK_MAP_MIN_TEXT_PX=11 projected px; Archify's 6px stays in the ported file. Fit and zoom-out stop at the floor; the map scrolls beyond it. Columns use available width, with 4 at 1280.
- Keep the v6 look: status pills tinted by map_status key, legend line, Due today/Waiting/Overdue chips per contract s8 predicates, and SVG search icon.
- Selection only: no writes, completion or lock path (#373). Task text is React text only. No network, model calls, fs/process/env or new deps. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md lists every ported file.
- Stacked on desktop#87 (T115 Tasks page, base t115-design): merge #87 first, then this retargets to main. Port spec: docs/design/task-map/port/spec.md. Also updates the #87 pick-up test to select through the map and the list (map is now the default view).

## Not ported
Route labels/collision placement, layout diagnostics, legend.mjs, i18n, schemas, cli and brand-marks (network).

## Screenshots (paths)
Before: docs/design/task-map/port/before/*.png (v6 prototype). After: docs/design/task-map/port/after/*.png (tasks-map, -focus, -narrow, -zoom; light and dark).

## Checks
<!-- swarm:checks -->
Local (after rebase on #87): `npm run typecheck` ok · `npx vitest run` 100 files / 1680 passed · eslint src+tests 0 errors (1 pre-existing warning) · `npm run build` ok. Rust untouched.

## Mutation check
Tests: tests/taskMap*.test.ts*, tasksPage, tasksLayout. M1 pill class by label: killed. M2 Due today counts completed: survived, then killed by a new test. M3 Overdue counts completed: killed. M4 overlaps never reported: killed. M5 readability floor 11->1: killed. M6 Waiting counts any linked task: killed.

## Needs Braden
Yes: UI and vendored third-party code. HELD for his typed merge.

## Open
Selecting a task with the detail panel open reflows the map from 3 to 2 columns to keep text >=11px (v6 kept 3 smaller columns). The 380px view shows the filter panel above the map (T115 page layout).
